title: Augmented singular cohomology, uniform matroids, and real-rootedness
summary: We study the singular cohomology rings of toric varieties associated with several fans arising from uniform matroids. These rings generalize the Chow and augmented Chow rings of matroids. For the singular cohomology ring arising from the augmented Bergman fan of a uniform matroid, we construct an explicit basis derived from the retral basis for the singular cohomology ring of a uniform matroid introduced by the first author.
